Kuvitus: talon seinän edessä on kaksi ma: Illustration: a wall of a house with two painter's trestles in front of it and a long plank on top of them. The right end of the plank reaches well beyond the right-hand trestle, and a paint can and a brush stand on the overhang. The painter stands on the ground next to the plank. The picture raises the question of how far along the overhang a load can be moved before the plank topples.
Kaavakuva, viivain pöydällä ylhäältä kat: Schematic figure, a ruler on a table seen from above, two cases. On the left, equal and opposite forces F1 and F2 pull the ends of the ruler along the ruler on the same line: the sum of the forces and the sum of the moments are zero, and the ruler does not rotate. On the right, equal and opposite forces act on the ends of the ruler perpendicular to it along different lines: the sum of the forces is zero but the sum of the moments is not, and the ruler starts to rotate, shown by a curved arrow.
Kaavakuva mittakaavassa: kaksi laatikkoa: Scale drawing: two boxes on the same 30 degree inclined plane, friction prevents sliding. The low box is 0.60 m wide and 0.60 m high, the tall box 0.30 m wide and 0.80 m high. From the centre of mass of each a vertical dashed line runs down to the plane. The line of the low box meets the base of the box, so it stays upright. The line of the tall box meets the plane outside the lower edge of the base, so it topples, shown by a curved arrow.
Voimakuvio: tasa-aineinen lankku kahden: Free-body diagram: a uniform plank on two supports, drawn as a rectangle. The weight G starts from the middle of the plank, the centre of mass, and points down. The support forces N1 and N2 point up and end at the lower surface of the plank at the supports. Support 1 is at the distance r1 from the centre of mass and support 2 at the shorter distance r2. The lengths of the arrows are to scale: N2 is longer than N1, and together they are as long as G.
Kaavakuva: vaakasuora tanko on saranalla: Schematic figure: a horizontal rod is on a hinge on a wall. A force F acts on the outer end of the rod, pointing obliquely up towards the wall and making the angle alpha with the rod. The force is resolved with dashed arrows into a component along the rod, which passes through the hinge and does not rotate the rod, and a component F sin alpha perpendicular to the rod, which gives a moment about the hinge. The lever arm of the moment is the length of the rod r.
Voimakuvio: tasa-aineinen hirsi suorakul: Free-body diagram: a uniform log as a rectangle. Carrier A is at the left end of the log and carrier B 1.00 m from the right end. The weight G starts from the middle of the log, downwards. The forces of the carriers NA and NB point up and end at the lower surface of the log. Distances: from A to the centre of mass 2.00 m, from the centre of mass to B 1.00 m. A is marked as the reference point and anticlockwise as the positive direction of rotation. The lengths of the arrows are to scale.
Opiskelijan piirtämä voimakuvio: tasa-ai: Free-body diagram drawn by a student: a uniform plank on two supports as a rectangle. Support 1 is 1.5 m and support 2 1.0 m from the middle of the plank. The weight G starts from the middle of the plank, downwards. The support forces N1 and N2 point up and end at the lower surface of the plank. The arrows N1 and N2 are equally long, and together they are as long as G.
Tilannekuva: uima-altaan reunalla on 4,0: Situation picture: at the edge of a swimming pool there is a 4.00 m long diving board. The back end of the board is fastened with a bolt to the concrete of the pool edge, and 1.50 m from the back end the board rests on a support beam. The front end of the board extends over the water, and a diver stands at its end. The board is uniform and horizontal.
Mallivoimakuvio: hyppylauta suorakulmion: Model free-body diagram: the diving board as a rectangle. The force of the bolt F_bolt starts from the back end of the board, downwards. The force of the support N points up and ends at the lower surface of the board 1.50 m from the back end; it is the longest arrow in the picture. The weight of the board G starts from the middle of the board, downwards, and the force of the diver F_d presses the upper surface of the front end of the board down. The lengths of the arrows are to scale: N is as long as the other three together.
Kuva mittakaavassa: kirjahylly, jonka sy: Scale drawing: a bookshelf of depth d = 0.400 m and height h = 1.80 m is tilted forwards so that it rests only on its front edge P. The centre of mass of the shelf is in the middle of the rectangle. A vertical dashed line runs from the centre of mass down to the front edge P, so the shelf is at the limit of toppling. The angle alpha is the angle between the vertical and the height direction of the shelf, that is, the front edge. Half of the base of the shelf, d/2, and half of the height, h/2, form a right-angled triangle whose hypotenuse is the vertical segment from the centre of mass to the edge P.
Kuva mittakaavassa: vaakasuora, 1,20 m p: Scale drawing: a horizontal rod of length 1.20 m is attached to a wall with a hinge. A sign hangs from the outer end of the rod. A cable runs from the outer end of the rod obliquely up to the wall, above the hinge, so that the angle between the cable and the rod is 30.0 degrees.
Mallivoimakuvio: keinulauta suorakulmion: Model free-body diagram: the seesaw as a rectangle, with the pivot in the middle of the board. The force of the child F_c presses the upper surface of the left end of the board down 1.50 m from the pivot. The force of the adult F presses the upper surface of the board down on the right of the pivot, 1.20 m from it. The weight of the board G starts from the middle of the board, downwards, and the force of the support N points up and ends at the lower surface of the board at the pivot; G and N are drawn side by side so that both can be seen. The positive direction of rotation is clockwise. The lengths of the arrows are to scale: F is 1.25 times as long as F_c, and N is as long as the other three together. The mass of the board is not given, so the length of G is chosen.
